subject.title: fix: forward response-frame meta to clients

question: Should this PR keep `res.meta` as an additive v4 response-envelope field after conflict resolution, or should the metadata contract be version-gated instead?
rationale: The code fix is narrow, but accepting a new top-level Gateway response field on protocol v4 is a compatibility policy choice for strict external clients that automation should not decide alone.

options.title: Accept additive v4 `res.meta`
options.body: Resolve the conflict, rerun checks, and land the optional `res.meta` field as an accepted additive v4 response-envelope extension.

options.title: Version-gate metadata
options.body: Require a protocol-version bump or negotiated capability before sending `meta` to clients that did not opt into the expanded envelope.

options.title: Pause this PR
options.body: Leave the PR unmerged until a broader Gateway protocol compatibility policy is settled.

recommendation.title: Accept additive v4 `res.meta`
recommendation.body: Resolve the conflict, rerun checks, and land the optional `res.meta` field as an accepted additive v4 response-envelope extension.
